review_scope: Five generated masters viewed individually; exact 256 export and cross-species contact-sheet review remain parent task. No game execution claim.

species_morphology.evidence: Rust-orange broad conical/umbonate cap, ochre stalk, pale flush cortina-remnant bands; no flaring Amanita-style rings.

style.evidence: Warm dark-brown outlines, simplified color regions and slight elevated three-quarter presentation match the supplied baseline sprites. No photographic texture, text, labels or habitat scene.
style.note: Some generated color planes contain subtle smooth shading/highlights rather than mathematically constant flat colors; final small-size style comparison remains parent review.

transparent_background.evidence: All five already RGBA with alpha 0..255 and transparent corner pixels; original generation bytes preserved. Very low-alpha edge specks exist in some masters; documented alpha>=16 framing ignores them for crop bounds without modifying master alpha.

plant_variations.evidence: A upright broad cap; B visibly tilted cap and curved stalk, both same maturity.

box_fill_levels.evidence: Low three loose pieces with most rear/right interior empty; corrected Medium around six recognizable caps loosely below rim; Full many overlaps in a clear above-rim mound.
box_fill_levels.container: Existing ochre front panel, right notch/end block, dark interior and camera retained across three fill variants.

notes: PlantA regenerated once to remove flaring skirtlike rings; final bands lie against the stalk.
Medium regenerated once because initial four-versus-three cap quantity step was weak; corrected version visibly spreads more caps.
